fields.System.Title: OUT-304 — Cancel a wave
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a supervisor, I want to cancel a wave that was released in error, so that pickers
are not working from a task list that should not exist.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a released wave with no picks confirmed, when I cancel it, then every pick
  • task is cancelled and the orders return to allocated — in one transaction.
  • - Given a wave with some picks already confirmed, then cancellation is rejected;
  • complete or short the picked lines first.
  • - Given cancellation, then allocations are not released — the orders stay allocated
  • and can be re-waved.
  • - Given cancellation, then no orphan pick task remains in any picker's list.
  • - Given cancellation, then the reason and acting user are recorded.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | outbound |
| Tables | wave, pick_task, order |
| Risks | Orphan pick tasks confirmed anyway ([doc 05 WF 5](../../../docs/05-workflows.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration · rollback |
